nativeMapping.layout: One normalized canvas for Home and in-game; no context-dependent media breakpoints.
nativeMapping.fontFamily: Motiva Sans, Arial, sans-serif (Steam-provided loaded font; Inter/Segoe not bundled)
nativeMapping.accent: Read shared Home memo first; hydrate its persisted artwork-versioned accent cache on menu open/reload. Prefer newer Home values and discard artwork-version races; Steam blue when no known game color.
nativeMapping.nativeChrome: Balanced HeaderStore/FooterStore visibility holds while custom menu active; restored on close/handoff/unload.
nativeMapping.nativeScrim: Only the backdrop containing the borrowed viewport is transparent while custom menu active.

backdropBlur.cssBackdropFilter: 20px, only on owner-document rounded panes matching bar, panel and Notifications
backdropBlur.renderer: Scoped owner-document CSS frosting for Steam pages; balanced Steam GamescopeService hold for games
backdropBlur.radiusUnits: Steam compositor service units, not CSS pixels
backdropBlur.reason: Popup CSS cannot sample another window. Owner-document panes blur Steam content only within measured menu bounds; native conditional blur handles game content. No full-screen popup background or blur mask; surrounding content stays clear. CSS20px and native32 use different units.

nativeMapping.positioning: Absolute centered canvas with transform scaling; no CSS zoom because Steam misreports its render bounds.
nativeMapping.cardShadow: Inset highlight only. Exterior drop shadow removed because its alpha expands the Gamescope blur mask beyond the rounded cards.
nativeMapping.outsideDismiss: Primary mouse click or touch-generated click outside the shell closes the menu; captured and consumed in the borrowed popup document, respects native modal/keyboard ownership.
nativeMapping.focusFill: 14% game-accent tint over transparent; user requested more contrast than mockup8%.
nativeMapping.sliderTrack: Track width calc(100% - 24px) matches native thumb-center travel at0%/100%; thumb positioning and setting adapters unchanged.
nativeMapping.surroundingChrome: Frosted notification pill with badge left of bell. Removed X, Game Glance caption and footer input hints. Compact ‹ L1 / R1 › indicators retained at bar ends; tab names retained.
nativeMapping.contrastRationale: Home40% glass,18% white edge and white700-weight action text, with stronger frosting confined to the menu surfaces.
nativeMapping.focusGeometry: 12px control corners,1px outline,2px offset for setting rows,1px offset for buttons. Native field backgrounds/outlines/shadows remain suppressed; notification retains its glass base while focused.
nativeMapping.sharedMaterial: src/styles/homeGlass.ts HOME_BUTTON_GLASS, consumed by Home and floating menu. Home rendered action-button values remain unchanged.
nativeMapping.ownedBackdrop: No full-screen dimming or filter. Three pointer-transparent rounded owner-document panes follow popup geometry and are removed on close/handoff/unload.
nativeMapping.shoulderIndicators: Mirrored full-height64px L1/R1 endcaps with inward separators, matching annotated screenshot.
nativeMapping.activeTab: Darker rgba(7,10,15,.45) glass, white text and accent inset edge, including while focused.
nativeMapping.moreTab: Ellipsis icon only; accessible name More retained.
nativeMapping.quickSettings: Icons for all controls;56px equal-height toggle rows, label and switch vertically centred, no Friends & Chat helper text.
